Output a result table containing the following columns: Health record number (in text format), year (e.g., 2025), and the number of physical examination records for that record number in that year. Output only the error data rows where the record count is ≥ 2, sorted in descending order by record count; if the count is the same, sort in ascending order by Health record number. If no error data exists, output "No error data found". Name the output table "Physical Examination Record Error Data".

# According to problem: descending by count, then ascending by health record number

print(f"Records in ref but not pred: {len(ref_records - pred_records)}")
print(f"Records in pred but not ref: {len(pred_records - ref_records)}")
